title: Qt: Improve keyboard navigation and visibility
description:
Enable tab for focus navigation between the main toolbar and the capture view (Filter, List, Details, Bytes) and cyclePane logic for standard Control+Tab navigation between functional areas. Explicitly hand off focus to the packet list when starting a capture.

Synchronize the focus cursor with the selection when entering data panes to allow immediate arrow-key navigation. Automatically scroll the active selection into view upon receiving focus. Ensure focus visibility on macOS by enabling standard focus rings for all major panes.

AI-Assisted: yes (Gemini)

\--

This is a general usability improvement to improve keyboard navigation but it is not explicitly about accessibility.
